comment: Four broken spiral arms of 2x2 pink petal blocks turning a quarter turn per loop, plus ~340 orbiting chunk petals and pale glints. Airy pink vortex about 240 px across, no outline. Origin is the centre.

A 6-arm spiral of block-broken pink petals turning over a sparse dark see-through backdrop. Six petal streams race along tilted great circles with depth, and orbiting petals and a bright broken rim (r~60) surround it. About 122 px across. Origin is the centre of the sphere.

Gold-white Master Sword silhouette drawn as a shape (blade, swept guard wings, grip, pommel) flying right, with a pulsing halo, a twinkling tip glint, and a sparkle and speed-line trail to the left. The sword spans x 45..159 at y 4..30. The origin is the middle of the sword, the tip is at origin+56. For an exact hitbox use a capsule (half-length 52, half-height 10). As a circle, use radius 30.

A golden-white shaft of holy light with a white core. It is about 30 px wide at the impact and narrows and fades toward the sky about 215 px above. Gold light-arrow streaks fall beside it. At the bottom: a flattened starburst, two expanding shock rings (r 10..40) and sparks thrown up. Origin is the impact point. Hit: a circle r 26 at the origin, or a column 30 px wide x 215 px up.

A black-red gloom column (rising noise inside drawn dark flame tongues) with a glowing crimson interior. Wavy crimson veins flow upward, thin dark tendrils curl out from the sides, and there is a malice pool at the foot with sludge chunks thrown up and red motes rising. Origin is the base on the ground. The body is about 40 px wide and 195 px tall above the origin. Hit: a column rect 40 x 190 above the origin, or a circle r 22 per 40 px of height.

One-shot ice burst. Frame 1 is a cold flash. Frames 2-6: twelve blue-white ice crystal spikes grow out to r~85 inside an expanding frost ring (to r 92). Frames 7-8: the crystals shatter in blocks into ~64 tumbling ice shards. Frames 8-11: cold mist puffs billow out and thin. Glints linger to frame 12. Origin is the centre. Hit: r 84 over frames 2-8.

Two glowing Blades of Chaos on curved grey chains whirl clockwise half a turn per loop (seamless by symmetry). Each blade drags a tapered orange fire trail (r 86) inside a ragged red outer flame, which together nearly close the circle, with burning puffs, orbiting embers and sparks. The blade tips reach r~113. The centre is empty for Kratos. Origin is the centre. Hit: an annulus r 70..100, or a circle r 96.
